subject.title: [Bug]: Browser interactions can exhaust model context by injecting too much page content

question: Should OpenClaw make compact goal-shaped browser output the default model-facing behavior, with raw page reads available only through explicit snapshot options?
rationale: Current main has opt-in efficient snapshots and caps, but changing default browser interaction semantics affects compatibility and product behavior beyond a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Make compact output the default
options.body: Adopt compact or goal-shaped browser reads and bounded post-action change reports as the normal agent path while preserving raw snapshots as an explicit escape hatch.

options.title: Keep opt-in efficient mode
options.body: Leave current defaults in place and treat browser.snapshotDefaults.mode='efficient' plus maxChars as the supported mitigation.

recommendation.title: Make compact output the default
recommendation.body: Adopt compact or goal-shaped browser reads and bounded post-action change reports as the normal agent path while preserving raw snapshots as an explicit escape hatch.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail for browser snapshot modes, default mode, and plugin ownership points to steipete-authored commits.
